name: Seahorse Cloud City
description: A floating city built on the back of a giant seahorse swimming through cotton candy clouds, with tiny buildings and spires dotting the seahorse's back and tail.
prompt: A massive seahorse swimming gracefully through fluffy pink and white cotton candy clouds. A tiny city with miniature buildings, spires, and bridges is built on the seahorse's back and along its curling tail. Sunset lighting casts warm orange and pink hues. Whimsical, dreamlike atmosphere, ultra-detailed, 8k
caption: Hold onto your seashells—we're going cloud riding! 🌊☁️🐴✨ This gentle giant carries an entire city on its back, swimming through skies painted with sunset colors. If you lived in this floating metropolis, what would your view look like every morning? The seahorse knows all the best routes!
